newsitem.title: FRANCE: Dollfus Mieg slumps as bubble bursts.
newsitem.headline: Dollfus Mieg slumps as bubble bursts.

text.p: French textile group Dollfus-Mieg et Cie (DMC) slumped nine percent at market open on Monday and was the biggest loser as the market's general fall kicked speculative air out of the share, dealers said.

The share had been gaining spectacularly in recent days on a rumour a buy-out bid was pending. The loss-making textile company said in July it expected first-half loss for 1997 to be of the same order as the 145 million net attributable loss for the first half of 1996.
At 0825 GMT, DMC was down 6.78 percent at 112.70 after a low of 110 francs.
